fields.label: Item Commission Percent
fields.description: Platform-wide default commission billed to the shop on the items portion of a settled order. Overridden per shop by a nonzero Shop.percentage.

fields.label: Delivery Commission Percent
fields.description: Platform-wide default commission billed to the deliveryman on the delivery fee of a settled order (0 = the driver keeps the whole fee, 100 = the platform takes it all). Overridden per driver by a Deliveryman Profile with Override Delivery Commission checked.
